review.market_summary: 1) Democrats' sweeping midterm win (House and Senate) is the dominant story. It triggered a relief rally led by consumer discretionary and a sharp oil selloff, but futures are now flat, so the easy move looks done. Tariff-rollback talk is mostly rhetoric: any repeal still faces a presidential veto. 2) Rates and inflation are hawkish but the signal is noisy. Headlines conflict on whether the Fed hiked or held. Inflation is at a 3-year high, eurozone CPI is at 4%, and JOLTS and ADP are strong. The Senate result also blocks a dovish Fed overhaul. Against that, crude down ~13% in a week is disinflationary and long bonds have rallied. 3) Tail risks the rally ignores: Taiwan reports a massive PLA naval mobilisation, and the Iran war remains unresolved even as Vance blames it for the election loss.
